text:
Lauren Chen: Quick sync — propose we run a 6-week DP for the Private deployment path focused on onboarding + rollback criteria. Goal: recruit 8 partners across fin/reg and scale apps. Thoughts on incentives + acceptance gates?

Jia Patel: +1. I'd pair $4k credits + 8 engineer-hours per partner. credits to be used on Dedicated or Private only.

Mark Rivera: Suggest split-test incentives: (A) credits + eng hours vs (B) reduced pricing + 3 months priority support. Measure acceptance rate and engagement.

Samir Gupta: Acceptance gates we should require:
- 2 successful end-to-end test runs (load + policy)
- SLA adherence: p95 latency within target for 3 straight days
- Provide 10 prompt/test cases for evals
If any gate fails twice, automatic rollback/escape hatch.

Lauren Chen: Proposed screening questions:
```
1) Primary use-case + latency SLO
2) Data residency / compliance constraints
3) Expected token volume/week
4) Contact for infra + legal
5) Any existing private infra? (yes/no)
```

Jia Patel: Add one: willingness to run a short canary in our staging for 48h.

Mark Rivera: Metrics to track during DP: activation (days-to-first-success), monthly active routes, eval regressions, cost delta vs baseline.

Samir Gupta: Rollback plan: feature flag with instant disable, preserved model-pinning fallback, and a 2-hour oncall rotation for first 2 weeks. Need runbook.

Lauren Chen: OK. Who wants to own recruiting outreach + screening form? @Jia Patel?

Jia Patel: I can own outreach + the Typeform. Will draft screening + incentive A/B plan by Thu. :+1:

Mark Rivera: I'll build the metric dashboard (console view) and wire alerts for eval regressions.

Samir Gupta: I'll draft rollback runbook and SLO checklist. Need a short legal blurb for credits usage — ping legal.

legal-bot: reminder: include NDA + data-processing addendum for partners handling PII. Contact: legal@redwood.ai

Ops-bot: calendar created — DP kickoff 2024-07-01 10:00 PDT. Invite sent.

Lauren Chen: Great. Next sync Friday 11am PT to finalize invites and split test groups. :rocket:
